theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  have h_inj : InjOn f s := by intro x y; cases hf x with a; cases hf y with b; rw [a, b]; exact funext
  have h_maps_to : MapsTo f s s := by intro x hx; exact ⟨f x, by simp [hf]⟩
  have h_bij : BijectiveOn f s := by refine ⟨h_inj, h_maps_to⟩
  have h_image_image : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
    rw [image_image]
    apply congr
    apply funext
    intro x
    rcases mem_image_iff.1 (mem_image_iff.2 ⟨x, mem_set_of_eq.2 rfl, rfl⟩) with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hz
  exact h_image_image
